{{Quote|Glad you like 'em, Dharus. Hey, all you smuggler types, this guy is a privateer in the Parmel and Portmoak region. Looks like you can make some quick money running him replacement parts for his FXs.|Cormun|<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''Cormun''' was an individual who posted in [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Cormun was familiar with the pirate activities of [[Dharus]]. When Dharus posted in the Datalog about his predilection for [[FX-series medical assistant droid/Legends|FX-series medical assistant droids]], Cormun replied to his post with information about Dharus and suggesting [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to make a profit selling him droid parts.<ref name="CFTD" /> A couple of years later, Cormun commented on the entry for the [[850.AA Public Service Headquarters]], passing on information that a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[clan]] reprogrammed one of the droids on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. As it passed by the home of a rival faction, the 850.AA deployed [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] to attack their enemies. Cormun was corrected by a fellow commenter, [[Sei'lya]], who was present during the event. The 850.AA disgorged [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[Seeker (droid)|Seekers]] that slammed into the building's defenses and exploded.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
